name: Поддержка проекта

findings.title: Realtime recovery does not recover subscription or clear obsolete load error
findings.proposedFix: Invalidate failed listener registration, retry explicitly and distinguish load errors from mutation errors; clear only obsolete load error after authoritative recovery. Keep last confirmed public config where safe.

findings.title: Maximum text leaves focused input hidden behind oversized save footer
findings.observed: UI automation successfully types/saves, but pixels show focused URL/message below visible content while keyboard and three-line save action consume the lower viewport. The long heading also consumes the first screen. Passing input assertions are not visual acceptance.
findings.proposedFix: Compact context-specific Save action, deliberate editor tab-bar policy, focus-aware scrolling and shorter heading. Inspect all final frames and native close confirmation at maximum text; do not globally shrink user text.

findings.title: Draft preview states that card is already shown to users before saving
findings.observed: Visible/hidden wording uses draft.isEnabled; shared confirmed config remains unchanged until Save. Preview is noninteractive by design, which should remain.
findings.proposedFix: Separate confirmed visibility from draft preview, label unsaved edits and say how the card will appear after saving. Put visibility/link controls before an optionally collapsed preview.

findings.title: Donation editor loading and authorization scope lag behind shared audit standard
findings.observed: No explicit not-requested phase: false isLoading/hasLoadedData maps to load-failed UI before the first request in isolation. Child dismissal and post-save success check use UID only rather than authorization revision. Root policy and server Rules do deny revoked roles; no unauthorized write or visible startup flash was demonstrated.
findings.proposedFix: Use explicit first-loading state, frozen command/principal/authority scope and post-await revision checks; retain root/server protection. Add held-response same-UID reauthentication and role-change scenarios.

findings.title: Support configuration save/failure has no dedicated actionable system-journal event
findings.observed: Direct Firestore write/readback and generic inline errors; no donation save/error emission or matching appConfig trigger found. Existing system-log donation target display does not create records. This does not assert that Google Cloud platform logs are absent.
findings.proposedFix: Record actor, operation, config revision, confirmed outcome and typed failure stage/code through existing journal pipeline; no invented success after ambiguous writes.

findings.title: Link check only launches browser; public launch failure is silent
findings.observed: Owner link action checks openURL acceptance, not endpoint availability. Public button ignores acceptance callback. Copy describes arbitrary HTTPS target as a secure site. No payment/provider-page availability failure was injected on real iPhone.
findings.proposedFix: Name the action Open link, use neutral external-site/domain wording and provide visible launch failure/retry or copy-link fallback; keep HTTPS/host validation. Do not add payment checkout or click tracking.

baseline.scope: 8 model/validation tests and3 ordinary/AccessibilityM owner UI scenarios. The opt-in SDK case skipped here ran explicitly below.

SDKAndRegressionProbes.scope: Existing9 cases pass including actual Swift SDK transaction/readback/stale conflict/stream. Two new intentionally red probes reproduce F01; not a green regression run. Probe source retained in ignored artifact, removed from source target.

verification.actualSDKBoundary: SDK transport uses isolated demo-uac-donation-client with permissive emulator rules and no production auth. Security authorization proven separately with live-matching Rules and16 isolated role contexts; not a combined real-owner SDK E2E claim.

roles.scope: Owner/warned/TOTP owner allowed; admin/org owner/admin/editor/user/blocked account/blocked state/MFA-incomplete/unverified/old legal/guest denied. All public reads allowed. Real organization membership document included. Valid passkey MFA allowed; revoked passkey epoch denied.

translationServer.scope: Actual Firestore handler contracts with injected provider; no real external translation provider/quality claim.

maximumUI.scope: AccessibilityXXXL/light; preview language switch, URL/title/message typing, lower controls, save-and-close and reopened exact title. Pixels demonstrate F02 despite functional success.

Corrected driver; AccessibilityXXXL/dark, explicit keyboard dismissal, both-language preview, exact URL/title/message persistence after save-and-close/reopen. Visual footer/confirmation issues remain separately open.

productionConfig.scope: Read-only source config, current hidden public entry is intended.

callableStartup.scope: Anonymous request denied before authenticated provider business path; actual JSON startup/routing only.

firstDEMaximumAttempt.meaning: Driver header tap focused another input; keyboard remained. Fixed test to tap real side margin, assert keyboard disappearance and calculate gesture inside current viewport. Not an additional product-defect claim.

closeAndTranslation.scope: Normal UK: close cancel preserves URL, confirmed discard/reopen removes unsaved URL, UK→DE overwrite-confirm/apply changes exact target, DE→UK cancel preserves original UK. Injected UI translation provider.

routeContracts.scope: Fresh entire core contract suite, includes actual profile authority case. Individual method filter in CloseAndDirections was discovered but not executed; only1 UI case is counted there.

hostedCI.scope: New hosted validation after source/test documentation commit is separate; no TestFlight gate is claimed passed.

performance.dataShape: One small appConfig/donation document, no whole-user/content collection scan or pagination.
performance.bootstrap: loadIfNeeded attaches a realtime listener and performs an explicit authoritative fetch: up to two initial document reads; subsequent identity loadIfNeeded uses cached loaded state.
performance.listenerLifetime: Single registration held by model; weak callback capture; registration cancellation on deinit. Terminal recovery defect recorded separately.
performance.limits: URL2048/title120/message2000/button80; read deadline20seconds; writes not cancelled by read deadline.
performance.measurementBoundary: No latency/CPU/memory trace or before/after speedup claimed.

recommendations: Keep one owner settings route and one conditional user support route; no new payment system or duplicate section needed.
Use compact heading, controls first, optional preview and clear unsaved/saved visibility.
Preserve independent voluntary support and existing user privacy/analytics choices; do not add unsolicited click tracking.
boundaries: Audit only: no product fix, production configuration change, Rules deployment, function deployment, actual payment or TestFlight upload.
No real registration/login, payment recipient edit or external provider translation requested.
Real signed iPhone, VoiceOver, reduced transparency/increased contrast, narrow/landscape and external-app return are separate pending acceptance.
Public card component inspected through noninteractive owner preview; enabled public route itself not freshly replayed under a real non-owner account.
Conflict/reload confirmation UI, true lost-ack transport injection and donation-specific same-UID held save/session switch remain follow-up scenarios, not closed by SDK happy-path or source reading.
countsMeaning: 34 inventory surfaces reviewed with per-row evidence; verified source/contracts is not proof of every runtime/physical variant. Six finding groups distinguish confirmed defects from source hardening/observability/copy gaps. No product fixes implemented in this audit.
